title: Clothes for New Delhi
content: The current weather in New Delhi is 24.1°C with 84% humidity. It's advisable to carry light, breathable clothing. An umbrella or light rain gear may also be useful in case of unexpected weather.

title: Clothing Suggestions for Hyderabad
content:
The current weather in Hyderabad is 30.1 °C with 45% humidity and no expected rain. 

**Clothing Suggestions:**
- Light cotton or breathable fabrics to stay comfortable in the heat.
- Short-sleeved shirts or T-shirts.
- Lightweight trousers or shorts.
- A hat or sunglasses for sun protection.
- Comfortable footwear for walking.
